display.purpose: Numerals and button type in capitals: hero totals clamp(2.8rem,5vw,6rem), balances 1.9rem, chart heads, 1.05rem buttons. Never inside tables.

stencil.purpose: Wordmark (1.55rem on ink, 2.6rem on auth) and section titles (1.5rem) inside red bands only.

body.purpose: Default page voice, 15px/1.55; every form value and table cell.

label.purpose: Field labels, marginal strips, footers: 0.7rem weight 500 uppercase, letter-spacing 0.09em. Chips run hotter: 0.66rem/700/0.1em.

data.purpose: font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums on all amounts, dates (8.5ch fixed), counts, percentages.

label-mini.purpose: Rotulación compacta: botones mini, chips y estampas.

meta.purpose: Columnas de datos marginales (franja, celdas meta del libro móvil).

small.purpose: Texto pequeño de control: selects de filtros, lecturas de bloque.

body-small.purpose: Campos compactos de captura y altas inline.

campo.purpose: Texto base de campos y avisos.

monto-movil.purpose: Montos del libro recompacto en teléfonos.

marca-auth.purpose: Marca grande de páginas de sesión.

data-svg.purpose: Etiquetas de eje de los carteles.

shadows.name: control-lift
shadows.purpose: Hard offset under primary buttons only (.btn-primario); cancelled on :active with translate(2px,2px).

shadows.name: surface-lift
shadows.purpose: Sheet-set-on-desk depth for the auth box (.auth-caja) and admin panel (.panel-admin). Zero blur, ink color, offset only.

motion.name: paso
motion.purpose: The only timing function in the system (--paso). All state change is a two-frame hard cut; controls otherwise carry transition: none.

motion.name: sello-cae
motion.purpose: New ledger row cuts from solid rojo block to paper — the stamp lands.

motion.name: total-brusco
motion.purpose: Totals block background cuts rojo-grafico to tinta when its currency is touched.

motion.name: estampa-pop
motion.purpose: ANOTADO rubber stamp snaps from scale 1.9 / 0.4 opacity to rest (rotate -6deg) in one hard frame.

motion.name: sello-marca
motion.purpose: The stamp at rest has no motion; under prefers-reduced-motion animations are removed and the mark is not generated at all.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single command action (REGISTRAR, INGRESAR): red block, paper Anton capitals, hard ink lift shadow that cancels on press.

components.name: Secondary Button

components.name: Field + Select
components.description: Ledger-grade input: pale card, 2px ink border, zero radius, mono type; select arrow is a pure-CSS triangle pair. Red caret and 3px red focus ring are global.
components.css: .ds-field-wrap { max-width: 320px; background: var(--papel); color: var(--tinta); padding: 16px; } .ds-campo-label { display: block; margin: 18px 0 6px; font-family: var(--mono, 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace); font-size: 0.7rem; font-weight: 500; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.09em; } .ds-campo { width: 100%; padding: 11px 12px; font-family: var(--mono, 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace); font-size: 0.95rem; background: var(--papel-claro); color: var(--tinta); border: var(--grosor, 2px) solid var(--tinta); border-radius: 0; caret-color: var(--rojo); accent-color: var(--rojo); } .ds-campo::placeholder { color: var(--tinta-2); opacity: 1; } .ds-campo:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--rojo); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-select { appearance: none; background-image: linear-gradient(45deg, transparent 50%, var(--tinta) 50%), linear-gradient(135deg, var(--tinta) 50%, transparent 50%); background-position: calc(100% - 18px) 55%, calc(100% - 11px) 55%; background-size: 7px 7px; background-repeat: no-repeat; padding-right: 34px; }

components.name: Section Band
components.description: The band IS the title: red block with the 26px single-cut corner, stencil type inside, capped at 42ch. No kicker above it, ever.

components.css: .ds-celda { position: relative; display: inline-block; background: var(--papel-claro); border: 2px solid var(--tinta); padding: 10px 14px; font-family: var(--mono, 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace); font-size: 0.88rem; color: var(--tinta); } .ds-sello-demo { font-size: 0.66rem; letter-spacing: 0.1em; background: var(--rojo); color: var(--papel); padding: 1px 6px; margin-right: 8px; } .ds-estampa { position: absolute; right: 8px; top: 50%; font-size: 0.66rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.12em; border: 2px solid var(--rojo); color: var(--rojo); background: var(--papel-claro); padding: 0 6px; transform: translateY(-50%) rotate(-6deg); animation: ds-estampa-pop 90ms steps(2, end) 1; pointer-events: none; } @keyframes ds-estampa-pop { from { transform: translateY(-50%) rotate(-6deg) scale(1.9); opacity: 0.4; } to { transform: translateY(-50%) rotate(-6deg) scale(1); opacity: 1; } } @keyframes ds-sello-cae { from { background: var(--rojo); color: var(--papel); } to { background: transparent; color: var(--tinta); } } .ds-fila-nueva { animation: ds-sello-cae 180ms steps(2, end) 1; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-estampa, .ds-fila-nueva { animation: none; } }

narrative.overview:
RFinance is a money desk set as a constructivist poster press. The page ground is aged bone paper (papel) with real grayscale grain multiplied over the token color; on it sit flat ink-black blocks, red clipped bands, and ruled data — no cards-with-rounded-corners, no accent-on-cream fintech default. The world is owner-pinned Soviet constructivism plus utilitarian brutalism, held sober: it behaves like a registration instrument, never a novelty. The product's multi-currency reality (ARS and USD side by side, "SIN CONVERSIÓN") is composed into the layout itself — two ink totals blocks, one per currency, are the first thing on the desk.

Three voices share the stage and never trade jobs: Saira Stencil One stamps the wordmark and section titles, Anton sets numerals and button type in capitals, and JetBrains Mono carries every piece of actual data in tabular figures. One diagonal-cut system governs every angle in the build: a 26px clip on section bands, −30° corner wedges on the auth box and totals blocks, and a lone −6° tilt reserved for the rubber-stamp state. Depth is press-depth — hard 2px/3px ink frames, flat fills, and offset drop shadows only under lifted primary controls. Motion is two-frame hard cuts at 90–180ms with steps(2, end); the signature moment, El Sello, stamps a newly recorded row ("ANOTADO") in one snap.

Status of this record (scan mode, captured 2026-10-14 from the shipped /, /login, /register surfaces): tokens and components below are evidenced in static/css/style.css (shared world) and static/css/dashboard.css (home composition). Open areas the build does not yet resolve: i18n — copy is Spanish-only, no EN mechanism exists yet (strings sit centralized in templates); admin surface — /admin is a placeholder that inherits the world via style.css (.panel-admin) with no composed content of its own; backend schemas — every ledger row, account, budget, and chart is synthetic in-memory demo data explicitly labeled "DE EJEMPLO", and no currency conversion is performed or faked. Whether income keeps ocre or moves to green is an open owner call (a single-token swap if it changes).
keyCharacteristics: Five materials doing semantic jobs; one diagonal-cut family; zero radius.
Anton giant numerals, stencil titles inside red clipped bands, mono for all data.
Ink blocks for structure, paper for field, concrete-grey for secondary panels.
Hard offset shadows only on lifted controls; everything else flat and framed by 2–3px ink borders.
Step-motion only (steps(2, end), 90–180ms); states cut, never ease.
Browser surfaces (selection, caret, focus ring, scrollbar) are themed in ink/red.
Dense ruled blocks float in wide paper margins; nothing is printed around them.

rules.name: The Semantic Labor Rule
rules.body: Every palette member has a job: rojo = egreso/déficit/acción primaria, ocre = ingreso/positivo, tinta/papel = estructura/ground, concreto = secundario. Never decorate with a color whose job the context contradicts — red never marks a success, ochre never marks an expense.

rules.name: The Texture-by-Blend Rule
rules.body: Material character comes from grayscale raster grain (.textures/papel-hueso.png, .textures/concreto.png, procedural with embedded provenance) multiplied over a token color — background-blend-mode: multiply — never from pre-tinted images or gradients. The color is always a :root token; the grain is always achromatic.

rules.name: The Mono-Means-Data Rule
rules.body: Anything that varies row to row — ledger cells, form values, dates, counts, chart labels — is JetBrains Mono with tabular figures. Anton numerals exist only as printed posters (headline totals, balances, chart heads), never inside tables.

rules.name: The No-Kicker Rule (as practiced)
rules.body: The red clipped band *is* the section title — no eyebrow line is ever printed above a heading. Small-caps mono text exists only when it does work: naming a field, carrying a date/currency/count, or declaring state (DEMO, EXCEDIDO, ANOTADO, DATOS DE EJEMPLO).

rules.name: The Full-Cell Recompress Rule
rules.body: When the grid narrows, cells re-compose as complete units — rows become stacked labeled blocks; a column is never left orphaned, and table.libro drops to min-width: 0 instead of scrolling.

rules.name: The Pressed-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Offsets are hard, 0-blur, and ink-colored; they appear only under primary actions and standalone sheets. A control's :active state cancels its shadow and shifts 2px down-right — depth is mechanical press, never atmosphere.

rules.name: The Single Cut Rule
rules.body: If an edge is slanted it came from one of exactly three sources: the 26px band clip, a −30° wedge, or the −6° stamp tilt. New angles are not added; the cut system also governs chart bar width (26px rects) and the seal — one angle across bands, bars, and sellos.

rules.name: The Zero-Radius Rule
rules.body: No corner is softened at any scale — not buttons, not inputs, not panels. Roundness is a defect in this world.

rules.name: The Destructive Isolation Rule
rules.body: Log out and delete controls are physically separated, rendered outline-at-rest, and only resolve on deliberate hover/focus. They never carry the primary action's red fill or lift shadow at rest.

rules.name: The Step-Cut Rule (no easing)
rules.body: Every state change is either instant (transition: none on controls) or a two-frame steps(2, end) cut at 90–180ms. Nothing fades, slides, or eases; under prefers-reduced-motion all animation is removed and stamp marks are not generated at all.

dos: Do source every color from the five :root materials; if a needed value isn't in :root, the design isn't done yet — extend the token, then use it.
Do keep the Semantic Labor assignment fixed: red for egreso/déficit/primary, ochre for ingreso/success, concrete for secondary, ink/papel for structure.
Do set all data in mono with tabular figures; reserve Anton numerals for poster-scale numbers only.
Do use the band as the only section-title treatment, clipped by --corte (26px) and capped at 42ch.
Do press with hard offsets: 4px 4px 0 under primary controls, 8px 8px 0 under standalone sheets, cancel-to-translate(2px,2px) on active.
Do cut states with steps(2, end) at 90–180ms or not at all, and honor prefers-reduced-motion.
Do isolate destructive actions in outline-at-rest form (.btn-peligro / .btn-salir pattern).
Do texture via multiply-blended grayscale rasters over a token color (bone paper on body, concrete on USD panels).
Do label provisional data honestly — "DE EJEMPLO" / DEMO chips stay until the backend is real.
Do recompact grids into full cells at 1024/640px; keep fecha, concepto, and monto visible in the mobile ledger row.
donts: Don't round any corner, blur any shadow, ease any motion, or float any glass — the world has none of these.
Don't invent diagonal angles: only the 26px band clip, the −30° wedge, and the −6° stamp tilt exist.
Don't paint success red or expense ochre; don't hand the primary-action red to anything decorative.
Don't add eyebrow/kicker lines above headings or decorative small-caps that carry no field, count, or state.
Don't use glyph-icon libraries — arrows and carets are CSS triangles; charts are inline SVG.
Don't fade between states; two-frame hard cuts or instant swaps only.
Don't fabricate financial data, conversion rates, or currency symbols — amounts arrive with their currency as a first-class label (a chip), and no cross-currency math is implied.
Don't ship unthemed browser surfaces on new pages — selection, caret, focus ring, and scrollbar inherit style.css globally; keep it that way.
